title.narrative: Ukraine Digital Emergency Response Services Project

description.narrative:
The planned Project consists of EUR 50 million investments targeting Public Protection and Disaster Relief networks modernisation in Ukraine, and specifically the rollout of a nationwide 112 call system. The 112 call system will cover the emergency call systems of activities of police, ambulance, fire brigades and gas emergency teams, focussed on maintaining public order and restoring situations back to normal in case of planned events or unplanned incidents and disasters.

The main objectives of the Project is to provide essential strengthening of the PPDR networks¿ capabilities through the implementation of a single emergency number 112 under the responsibility of the Center of Infrastructure and Technologies of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Ukraine.

The Project will create a single emergency number `112¿ that is supported by a modern technological platform, operational model, and European standards. Operational benefits include increased quality and efficiency resulting from an advanced emergency system and new ways of working with emergency operations for all participating Emergency Response Organizations. The new system 112 will be operated by a 112 Agency under the direct governance of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. Overall, the new system 112 will create significant socio-economic benefits for citizens, property, businesses and environment in Ukraine. The new system 112 will connect all four emergency response organisations (police, fire brigade/state emergency service, ambulance and gas) to the same system.

The main objectives of creating a national emergency 112 call system are:

(1)accelerating the exchange of information between the subjects of the system 112;

(2)increasing the efficiency of organizational and managerial activities and promote the timeliness of adequate management decisions by the subjects of the system 112;

(3)providing information and analytical support for the activities of the subjects of the system 112.

The Project will support a key public initiative with a strong focus on civilian security, and contribute to the continuation and upgrade of the existing digital infrastructure. Given the continuous attack on Ukraine¿s systems, the investments to support the institutions in charge of these systems are of utmost importance for the country and will cover digital needs in the spheres of civil defence, rescue, utilization of radioactive waste, protection of population and territory in emergency situations, and emergency prevention and response.
